title: Rust: Observer Pattern
description: Implement the observer pattern with event subscription and notifications.

steps.title: Define Observer Trait
steps.description: Define a trait `Observer` with method `fn update(&self, event: &str)`. Create two structs `EmailNotifier` and `SmsNotifier` that implement Observer and print different messages.

verification.failureMessage: Print notifications from both Email and SMS notifiers.

steps.title: Event Emitter
steps.description: Create an `EventEmitter` struct that holds a list of observers (`Vec<Box<dyn Observer>>`). Add methods `subscribe(&mut self, observer: Box<dyn Observer>)` and `emit(&self, event: &str)`.
hints: `emit` iterates over observers and calls `.update(event)` on each.
Subscribe both notifiers and emit an event.

steps.title: Topic-Based Events
steps.description: Extend EventEmitter to support multiple topics using a `HashMap<String, Vec<Box<dyn Observer>>>`. Add `subscribe(topic, observer)` and `emit(topic, event)`. Test with "order" and "payment" topics.
hints: `HashMap<String, Vec<Box<dyn Observer>>>` as the observer storage.
Only observers of that topic receive the event.

steps.title: Unsubscribe
steps.description: Add an `unsubscribe` method that removes an observer by ID. Use a counter to assign unique IDs to each observer. Demonstrate subscribing then unsubscribing.
hints: Give each observer a unique `id: usize`.
`fn unsubscribe(&mut self, id: usize)` removes the observer.
After unsubscribe, the removed observer stops receiving events.

verification.failureMessage: Subscribe an observer, then unsubscribe and verify it no longer receives events.

steps.title: Closure-Based Observers
steps.description: Add support for closure-based observers: `on<F>(&mut self, topic: &str, callback: F) where F: Fn(&str) + 'static`. Subscribe both a named struct and a closure, emit an event.
hints: Store them alongside trait observers or as a separate list.

verification.failureMessage: Subscribe a closure observer and emit an event.
